description.zh: bm 词：搜 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 的书签（含账户书签），支持拼音，Enter 打开；在设置里打开后，bh 词 搜浏览历史
description.en: bm words: searches Chrome, Edge and Firefox bookmarks, account ones too, by pinyin as well; Enter opens. Once turned on in the settings, bh words searches the browsing history

notes.zh: 能搜 Firefox 的书签和历史记录：每个 Firefox 配置文件（安装版和应用商店版）都读，书签按 Firefox 里的文件夹排列；LibreWolf、Zen 之类在设置里指定 places.sqlite 即可。新增读取 Firefox 书签文件的权限，更新时会请你确认。
notes.en: Firefox bookmarks and history: every Firefox profile (installer and Store builds) is read, bookmarks under Firefox's own folders; LibreWolf, Zen and the like work by naming their places.sqlite in the settings. It now asks to read Firefox's bookmark files, so the update asks you to confirm.
